title: 第6章 圣女羞怒，一夜入品
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
“江梦璃。”

    陈然的声音很轻。

    但这几个字落在红莲魔女耳中，却无异于九天惊雷，炸得她脑海中一片空白。

    她猛地抬头，那双原本充满魅惑的美眸此刻瞪得滚圆，死死盯着眼前这个年轻的狱卒。

    瞳孔剧烈收缩，呼吸都停滞了一瞬。

    “你……你说什么？”

    她的声音在颤抖，

    这个秘密，是她心底最深处的禁忌。

    除了红莲教那几个的核心长老，根本没人知道！

    就连大魏朝廷的镇魔司，查了整整十年，也只知道她是红莲圣女，根本不知道她还是前朝皇室的遗孤！

    这个小小的狱卒，怎么可能知道？！

    难道……他是那个组织的人？

    无数个念头在江梦璃脑海中疯狂闪过，恐惧如同冰冷的毒蛇，瞬间缠绕住她的心脏。

    陈然看着她那副惊骇欲绝的表情，嘴角勾起一抹玩味的弧度。

    要的就是这个效果。

    探查之眼的效果确实好用。

    攻心为上。

    他没有回答，而是缓缓伸出手。

    江梦璃下意识地想要后退，可只是身上的锁链晃了晃。

    退无可退。

    她只能眼睁睁地看着那只手越来越近。

    陈然的手并没有直接落在她的脸上，而是轻轻挑起了她额前凌乱的发丝。

    一张绝美得令人窒息的脸庞，彻底暴露在昏暗的灯光下。

    肤如凝脂，眉若远山。

    哪怕是在这阴暗潮湿的天牢里，哪怕身陷绝境，这张脸依旧美得惊心动魄。

    “啧啧。”

    陈然摇了摇头，发出一声由衷的感慨。

    “卿本佳人，奈何做贼？”

    “这么漂亮的一张脸，整天戴着面具装神弄鬼，不累吗？”

    江梦璃愣住了。

    她预想中的杀机、审讯、或者严刑逼供都没有发生。

    这个狱卒，竟然在……夸她好看？

    就在她愣神的瞬间。

    陈然的手指顺势下滑，捏住了她脸颊上的软肉，轻轻掐了一下。

    Q弹，软嫩。

    “手感确实不错，比我想象中还要好。”

    陈然淡淡道：

    轰！

    江梦璃只觉得一股热流直冲脑门，原本苍白的脸颊瞬间羞得通红，还带着一股怒意。

    她堂堂前朝公主，红莲圣女，平日里那些男人连看她一眼都要小心翼翼，生怕被挖了眼珠子。

    可现在，竟然被一个卑贱的狱卒，像逗弄宠物一样捏脸？！

    而且……而且他还靠得那么近 。

    近到她能清晰地闻到他身上那股淡淡的皂香味，还有属于年轻男子的阳刚气息。

    “你……放肆！”

    江梦璃羞愤欲绝，咬着银牙，从牙缝里挤出两个字。

    如果眼神能杀人，陈然现在已经被她千刀万剐了。

    “嘘——”

    陈然竖起食指，做了个噤声的手势，完全无视了她的杀人目光。

    他突然压低了声音，身体前倾，整个人几乎贴在了面前，阴影将江梦璃完全笼罩。

    “别叫那么大声。”

    “看看这周围。”

    陈然指了指四周昏暗死寂的牢房。

    “丁字号狱卒房，偏僻得很。”
content_en:
"Jiang Mengli."

    Chen Ran's voice was very soft.

    But when these words fell into the ears of the Red Lotus Witch, they were like thunder from the sky, causing her mind to go blank.

    She raised her head suddenly, and her beautiful eyes that were originally full of charm were now widened, staring at the young jailer in front of her.

    His pupils contracted violently, and his breathing stopped for a moment.

    "You...what did you say?"

    Her voice trembled,

    This secret is the deepest taboo in her heart.

    Except for the core elders of the Red Lotus Sect, no one knows about it!

    Even the Demon Suppressing Division of the Wei Dynasty, after investigating for ten years, only knew that she was the Red Lotus Saint, and had no idea that she was an orphan of the previous royal family!

    How could this little jailer know? !

    Could it be... that he is from that organization?

    Countless thoughts flashed crazily in Jiang Mengli's mind, and fear instantly wrapped around her heart like a cold poisonous snake.

    Chen Ran looked at her horrified expression, and the corners of his mouth curved in amusement.

    This is the effect you want.

    The effect of the Exploring Eye is really useful.

    Focus on the heart.

    He didn't answer, but slowly stretched out his hand.

    Jiang Mengli subconsciously wanted to retreat, but the chains on her body shook.

    There is no way to retreat.

    She could only watch as the hand got closer and closer.

    Chen Ran's hand did not fall directly on her face, but gently lifted the messy hair on her forehead.

    A breathtakingly beautiful face, completely exposed in the dim light.

    Her skin is like gelatin, and her eyebrows are like distant mountains.

    Even in this dark and humid sky prison, even in desperate situation, this face is still breathtakingly beautiful.

    "Tsk, tsk."

    Chen Ran shook his head and let out a heartfelt sigh.

    "How can I be a thief when I am a beautiful woman?"

    "With such a beautiful face, aren't you tired of wearing a mask and pretending to be mysterious all day long?"

    Jiang Mengli was stunned.

    None of the murderous intent, interrogation, or torture she expected took place.

    This jailer was... praising her for her beauty?

    At the moment when she was stunned.

    Chen Ran's fingers slid down, pinched the soft flesh on her cheek, and pinched it gently.

    Q elasticity, soft and tender.

    "It feels really good, better than I expected."

    Chen Ran said calmly:

    Boom!

    Jiang Mengli felt a rush of heat rushing straight to her forehead, and her pale cheeks instantly turned red with embarrassment and anger.

    She was a majestic princess, the Red Lotus Saint. Normally, men would be careful even to look at her, for fear of having their eyes gouged out.

    But now, his face is being pinched like a pet by a despicable jailer? !

    And...and he's still so close.

    So close that she could clearly smell the faint scent of soap on his body, as well as the masculine scent of a young man.

    "You... are presumptuous!"

    Jiang Mengli was so ashamed and angry that she gritted her silver teeth and squeezed out two words from between her teeth.

    If looks could kill, Chen Ran would have been cut to pieces by her now.

    "Shh-"

    Chen Ran raised his index finger and made a silent gesture, completely ignoring her murderous gaze.

    He suddenly lowered his voice and leaned forward so that his whole body was almost in front of him, and the shadow completely enveloped Jiang Mengli.

    "Don't scream so loud."

    "Look around here."

    Chen Ran pointed to the dark and silent cells around him.

    "The T-shaped jailer's room is very remote."
title_en: Chapter 6 The Saint is ashamed and angry, and becomes a master in one night
